def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    foreground = next(value for value in counts if value != background)
    return [[0 if value == foreground else foreground for value in row] for row in grid]
